title: 方言税：语言建模流程中持续存在的方言偏见
summary: 该研究追踪了语言模型流水线中的“方言税”，发现从分词、预训练、后训练到推理，模型对非标准英语方言（如AAVE）的编码和处理均存在系统性偏差。即使使用字符级分词器，性能差距依然存在，表明方言偏见在建模各阶段累积。
summary_en: This study traces the 'dialect tax' across the NLP pipeline, finding systematic biases against non-standard English dialects (e.g., AAVE) in tokenization, pre-training, post-training, and inference. Even character-level tokenizers fail to eliminate performance gaps, indicating biases accumulate at every stage.
